pr.title: Rename --output to --out
pr.description: Shortens the manifest output flag to match the sibling CLIs.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+# reviso-sync
+
+Syncs the local manifest with the server.
+
+## Usage
+
+Run `reviso-sync --output <path>` to write the merged manifest to a file
+instead of stdout. Pass `--dry-run` to print the plan without writing.
